categories.main_business_segments: Henan Xinning Modern Logistics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in integrated supply chain logistics services with a focus on bonded warehousing for electronic components, serving the 3C electronics industry. Its services include warehousing management and distribution, freight forwarding, import-export customs clearance, smart supply chain solutions, intelligent IoT and Beidou positioning services. The company is expanding into new sectors such as new energy vehicles and fast-moving consumer goods supply chains, and is developing international logistics operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including 5G, artificial intelligence, IoT, cloud computing, and Beidou satellite positioning to enhance intelligent warehousing and logistics operations. It has developed proprietary warehouse management systems (WMS), warehouse control systems (WCS), transportation management systems (TMS), and smart logistics equipment integration. Key innovations include automated picking systems with light guidance, intelligent storage with AGVs, and digital platforms for real-time logistics data and customer service.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are manufacturing enterprises in the 3C electronics sector, including brands like Lenovo, Motorola, Compal, and Asus. The company also serves clients in the new energy vehicle industry, fast-moving consumer goods, and tobacco logistics. Geographically, it serves major industrial regions in China such as East China, Central China, South China, and Southwest China, and is expanding its international customer base in Southeast Asia and beyond.
categories.geographic_coverage: Henan Xinning operates extensively across China with key logistics hubs and operations in cities including Kunshan, Suzhou, Shanghai, Wuhan, Chengdu, Chongqing, Shenzhen, Nanchang, Foshan, and Zhengzhou. It has established international presence with subsidiaries and operations in Singapore, Vietnam, and Hong Kong, supporting cross-border logistics and global supply chain services.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing integrated logistics, warehousing, distribution, customs clearance, and value-added services. It acts as a third-party logistics provider offering end-to-end supply chain solutions from raw material storage to finished goods distribution and after-sales spare parts logistics.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on digital transformation and intelligent logistics innovation, emphasizing the development of smart warehousing, IoT integration, AI-driven logistics management, and satellite positioning technologies. R&D efforts target enhancing system integration capabilities, developing cloud-based logistics platforms, and expanding intelligent equipment applications to improve operational efficiency and customer service quality. The company also prioritizes expanding into new sectors like new energy vehicles and international markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service fees from warehousing and value-added logistics services, freight forwarding, customs clearance, and delivery services. Additional income streams include sales of intelligent logistics equipment and software solutions, as well as satellite positioning and IoT service subscriptions. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model with contracts and service agreements with industrial clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Henan Xinning is positioned as a leading integrated supply chain logistics provider in the 3C electronics manufacturing supply chain with strong brand recognition and competitive advantages in intelligent warehousing and digital logistics solutions. It competes with other third-party logistics providers specializing in industrial and bonded logistics services. The company leverages its technology capabilities and regional network to maintain a competitive edge, especially in smart logistics and international expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 480.7 million, representing a 16.44% year-over-year increase. Despite continued net losses, the net loss attributable to shareholders narrowed by 53.44% compared to the previous year. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 567.4 million and equity attributable to shareholders of approximately RMB 200.9 million. It is in a recovery phase with improving revenue growth and operational efficiency, supported by capital injections and debt restructuring.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Henan Xinning emphasizes its nearly 30 years of experience in integrated supply chain logistics, combining advanced technology with customized service models such as VMI and smart logistics centers. Its value proposition lies in delivering high-quality, cost-effective, and technologically advanced logistics solutions tailored to the specific needs of high-tech manufacturing sectors. The company differentiates itself through its intelligent warehousing systems, comprehensive supply chain integration, and strong capabilities in international logistics and customs clearance, enabling clients to reduce costs and improve supply chain efficiency.
